ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, as amended; Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14; Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on Enterprise Registration; Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 02/2022/QH15, effective 1 March 2023; Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP of 7 May 2023 providing implementing details of the AML Law; State Bank of Viet Nam implementing circulars on AML/CFT and beneficial owner identification. Viet Nam does not maintain a public UBO register; beneficial-owner records are prepared and retained internally by the reporting LLC and are accessible to the State Bank of Viet Nam and relevant competent authorities only upon lawful demand.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of valid passport of each proposed individual member, UBO, and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport / civil registration authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by competent authority in country of origin; if the country is not a Hague Apostille Convention Contracting Party, Viet Nam Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / business registration extract of each corporate shareholder and direct or indirect corporate member in the ownership chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or competent corporate registrar in the jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Viet Nam Consular Legalization, followed by certified Vietnamese translation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Articles 21-22, 31, 42, 44, 46-48, 54, 58, 63-67, 77-97); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Articles 22-24, 36-39, 60); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration (Articles 21-33, Forms I-1 through III-17); Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP detailing the Law on Investment and implementing investment registration (Articles 30-32); Circular No. 02/2019/TT-BTC on registration fees; Law on Foreign Exchange No. 06/2005/QH12 and Circular No. 19/2014/TT-NHNN and Circular No. 06/2019/TT-NHNN on foreign-invested enterprise deposit accounts and direct investment capital (DICA).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office and Investment Registration Authority, Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or centrally-governed city where the registered office is located; national processing through the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) and the National Public Service Portal (dichvucong.gov.vn). The DPI accepts and issues both the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) for foreign-invested LLCs.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Joint Dossier for Issuance of Investment Registration Certificate and Enterprise Registration Certificate (Bộ Hồ sơ đăng ký đầu tư và đăng ký doanh nghiệp), consisting of: (1) Document on request for IRC issuance (Form I-1 of Decree 31/2021/ND-CP); (2) Written application for enterprise registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp, Form No. 1 of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP); (3) Draft Company Charter; (4) Member List (Form III-3) and capital contribution dossiers; (5) Notarized lease or certificate of location use right for the registered office; (6) Power of attorney and copies of investor identity documents.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum charter capital is imposed on a limited liability company in Vietnam for ISIC 6499 (non-dilutive revenue-based financing), nor is a mandatory escrow account required under the Enterprise Law. The charter capital is declared by the members and is freely agreed, but must be fully contributed within 90 days from the ERC issuance under Article 75 of Law on Enterprises 2020. Since the company is a foreign-invested entity conducting revenue-based financing, it must open a Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at a licensed bank in Vietnam and contribute capital in convertible foreign currency or VND in accordance with Circular 06/2019/TT-NHNN. For counterparty credibility and compliance with institutional fund agreements, a prudential declared charter capital of at least USD 300,000 (or VND equivalent) is recommended; the declared capital must be wired from the investor's offshore account into the Company's DICA and be evidenced by a capital contribution certificate signed by the General Director. No State escrow or bank-guarantee deposit is mandated, but the Company must ensure the capital remitted is consistent with the IRC-registered investment capital to avoid exchange-control sanctions and future profit-repatriation blockage.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION OF THE MEMBERS OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY ADOPTED BY WRITTEN CONSENT PURSUANT TO ARTICLES 54, 58, 63 AND 64 OF THE LAW ON ENTERPRISES NO. 59/2020/QH14.

Date: [INSERT DATE] Place: [INSERT CITY], VIET NAM

The undersigned, being the sole member(s) holding collectively 100% of the charter capital of [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY (the 'Company'), hereby adopt this written Resolution on the establishment of the Company and its initial corporate governance and operational authorization:

1. INCORPORATION AND CHARTER: The Company shall be established as a foreign-invested limited liability company with one member under the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, and Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP. The attached draft Company Charter is approved. The authorized representative is directed to execute the Charter and submit the enterprise registration dossier to the Department of Planning and Investment for the issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate following the Investment Registration Certificate.

2. REGISTERED OFFICE AND DOMICILE: The registered office and domicile of the Company shall be at [FULL ADDRESS, FLOOR, BUILDING, WARD, DISTRICT, CITY/PROVINCE, VIET NAM]. The General Director is authorized to execute and notarize the office lease and to file the location documents with the Business Registration Office. All legal notices and court process shall be served at this address.

3. SHARE CAPITAL AND SUBSCRIPTION: The charter capital of the Company is fixed at VND [AMOUNT] (in words: [AMOUNT IN WORDS]) divided as follows: [Member A: VND [AMOUNT], [PERCENTAGE]%]; [Member B if any: VND [AMOUNT], [PERCENTAGE]%]. Each member confirms full subscription to its allocated capital contribution and undertakes to contribute such amount fully in cash (or assets as stated) within ninety (90) days from the Enterprise Registration Certificate date, through the Company's Direct Investment Capital Account opened at a licensed commercial bank in Viet Nam. The General Director shall issue capital contribution certificates to each contributing member.

4. LEGAL REPRESENTATIVE AND OFFICERS: [FULL NAME], passport number [NUMBER], permanent address [ADDRESS], is appointed as the Company's legal representative under Article 12 of the Law on Enterprises, holding the position of Chairman of the Member Council. [FULL NAME], passport number [NUMBER], is appointed as General Director of the Company, authorized to manage the day-to-day business, to execute financing agreements, employment contracts, bank instruments, and tax filings. The General Director shall act within the authority limits under Article 65 of the Law on Enterprises and the Company Charter. In any event where the Chairman of the Member Council is unavailable, the General Director shall serve as sole legal representative only upon a separate written resolution.

5. CORPORATE SEAL, BANK ACCOUNTS AND SIGNATURES: The Company shall adopt a corporate seal under Article 42 of the Law on Enterprises; the seal specimen shall be declared on the National Business Registration Portal within seventy-two (72) hours. The Chairman of the Member Council and the General Director are jointly and severally authorized to (a) open a Direct Investment Capital Account and operational accounts at licensed banks; (b) designate two-authorized-signature banking protocols; and (c) execute subscription and investment documentation for the Revenue-Based Financing Fund.

6. BUSINESS SCOPE AND OPERATIONAL AUTHORIZATION: The Company is authorized to carry out ISIC 6499 activity, namely non-dilutive revenue-based financing for digital brands, including originating, underwriting, monitoring and collecting payments calculated as a fixed percentage of licensees' or e-commerce merchants' revenues. The General Director is directed to: (i) implement a written AML/KYC and sanctions-compliance manual aligned with Circular 09/2023/TT-NHNN (or the current lawful successor); (ii) ensure that no deposit-taking or consumer-lending activities prohibited to non-credit institutions are undertaken; and (iii) obtain legal confirmation of the usury threshold under Civil Code No. 91/2015/QH13 (interest rate shall not exceed 20% per annum unless authorized by commercial law provisions).

7. TAX AND REGULATORY FILINGS: The Chairman and General Director are directed to complete tax registration, social insurance registration, and the issuance of a digital signature certificate within the statutory deadlines, and to designate the Company's fiscal year as the calendar year. The General Director is empowered to retain auditors, tax agents and legal counsel for implementing transfer-pricing documentation (Circular 132/2020/TT-BT) and foreign-contractor tax compliance.

8. EFFECTIVENESS AND POWERS: This Resolution is effective immediately upon execution and governs until revoked by a subsequent written resolution of the members. Each officer is granted all ancillary powers reasonably required to execute this Resolution, and any third party may rely upon certified copies hereof.

ADOPTED by the written consent of all members on [DATE].

[SIGNATURE OF MEMBER A] [SIGNATURE OF MEMBER B] Name: Name: Title: Title: [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prerequisites: Execute, apostille/consularize, and notarize founding documents for the foreign-invested LLC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial VN Notary Public Office (Phòng Công chứng) for notarized Vietnamese-language copies; Ministry of Foreign Affairs Consular Department or the Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate for legalization/apostille of investor entity documents; the overseas corporate registry of the investor's home State for certified certificates of incorporation and good standing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before filing, the foreign investor must prepare and legalize: (i) certificate of incorporation and good standing of each corporate investor (or passport of each individual investor) duly consularized or apostilled and translated into Vietnamese; (ii) a signed written Company Charter in Vietnamese; (iii) a notarized office lease or a document confirming lawful right to use the registered address; (iv) financial reports or a bank letter evidencing financial capacity to commit the charter capital; (v) a power of attorney appointing the legal representative in Viet Nam, notarized and legalized. All Vietnamese translations must be certified by a Vietnamese notary or an authorized translation agency. Use the official forms of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP (Forms I-1, No.1, and III-3) and obtain an e-signature certificate from an approved certification authority (e.g., Viettel-CA, VNPT-CA) for online submissions.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation and statute/bye-laws of the foreign corporate investor (or passport copies of individual investors) with consular legalization/apostille and Vietnamese certified translation
Certificate of good standing / corporate status document issued within 3 months (if corporate investor)
A certified Vietnamese translation of the proposed Company Charter as signed by the investor
Notarized office lease contract or certificate of lawful use of the registered premises (floor area, address, building ownership papers)
Financial capacity evidence: bank reference letter certifying available funds for capital transfer or audited financial statements of the investor (most recent year)
Power of attorney and passport copy of the appointed legal representative of the Company in Viet Nam
6-month no-bankruptcy statement (if corporate investor) in accordance with Decree 31/2021
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or competent authority queries any document (e.g., missing legalization, translated-name mismatch), the applicant shall cure the dossier within five (5) working days by re-submitting the apostilled original or a corrected translation; a request for re-perfection of documents must be remedied without resubmitting fees unless the notary locates substantive non-conformity; if the Vietnamese translation is deficient, engage a licensed judicial translation office and re-notarize.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the Joint Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) dossier with the Department of Planning and Investment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province/city of the proposed registered office; submission via the National Public Service Portal (dichvucong.gov.vn) or the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn); the Investment Registration Authority under the DPI for IRC issuance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the National Single-Window portal using the e-signature; complete the electronic Form I-1 (request for investment registration) and Form No.1 (application for enterprise registration) with the specific scope code ISIC 6499 and the business lines declared as 'Capital finance and investment management; non-dilutive revenue-based financing for digital commerce brands'. Attach the notarized Vietnamese translation of the Company Charter, member list, capital contribution schedule, office lease, investor legalization, and financial capacity papers. Verify that the proposed project does not require investment policy approval under Article 30 of Law on Investment 2020 (credit institutions, insurance, etc.) and does not fall within conditional sectors requiring other licenses; because the activities are not in the list of conditional investment sectors, the DPI will issue the IRC within 15 working days. Pay the VND 300,000 IRC issuance fee (approx. USD 12) and VND 100,000 ERC registration fee (approx. USD 4.0) electronically. Monitor the 'one-stop' receipt/monitoring portal for the resolution. After IRC issuance, the system automatically or the applicant manually applies to the Business Registration Office for the ERC with the IRC number.
required_dossiers: Form I-1 IRC request (electronic)
Form No.1 Enterprise Registration Application (electronic)
Draft Company Charter in Vietnamese signed by investor and legal representative
Member List (Form III-3) with notarized signatures and capital contribution ratios
Notarized copy of the office lease or location-use documentation
Consularized/apostilled certificate of incorporation and good standing of investor
Financial capacity letter from a bank or audited financial statements
Power of attorney appointing the legal representative
Statement that the project does not require investment policy approval (as applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a query letter is issued, the DPI must list incomplete items; the applicant has the remainder of the statutory 15-working-day period plus at most 3 working days to complete the dossier (DPIs routinely allow a one-time re-submission window in the online portal). If the application is denied, the DPI must issue a written refusal stating legal grounds; the investor may either file a corrected/amended application or appeal the refusal to the Chairman of the Provincial People's Committee within 30 days, or initiate court proceedings in the provincial Administrative Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) and publish the enterprise establishment notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office (Phòng Đăng ký kinh doanh) under the DPI; electronic portal of the National Business Registration Portal for the publication of enterprise information.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receiving the IRC with the investment project registration number, the applicant completes the final ERC process on dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn: confirm the Company name (including the corporate name, translated name, and short name), legal representative, registered office, and the list of business lines as per ISIC 6499. The Business Registration Office verifies that the name does not conflict with existing registrations, under Article 38-41 of Decree 01/2021, and issues the ERC with the unique enterprise code (which doubles as the tax identification number) within 3 working days of validity. Ensure the ERC accurately reflects the foreign-investment ratio. After issuance, publish the establishment notice electronically on the National Business Registration Portal within 30 days (the system performs this automatically upon ERC issuance and charges a publication fee of VND 500,000, approx. USD 20). The ERC, IRC and published notice together form the conclusive proof of legal incorporation.
required_dossiers: Valid IRC number and dossier reference
Electronic form confirmation of enterprise registration with final company name, address, and business lines
Legal representative's information and passport scanned copy
Seal design choice (to be declared later) - no document required at this step
Payment evidence of registration fees
Approved Company Charter
Member contribution schedule (to be filed within 90 days if capital is not yet paid)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ERC is rejected due to name conflict or incomplete data, the applicant must file an amended name application with alternatives; the DPI's refusal letter must be cured by re-submission through the portal with corrections, and if rejected twice on the same grounds without legal basis, the applicant may lodge a specified complaint to the provincial People's Committee or initiate a court proceeding. Untimely publication notices trigger an administrative penalty from VND 10-15 million; the publication can be made retroactively through the portal with late-payment interest.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adopt the First Members' Resolution, declare the corporate seal sample, and execute corporate governance records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company's Member Council / General Director (internal corporate organ); National Business Registration Portal for seal-specimen declaration; provincial Public Security (Ministry of Public Security, Fire Prevention Police) only for the seal engraving if a physical seal is chosen (completed at a licensed seal-carving entity registered with the Public Security office).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the pro forma First Board Resolution (as set out in the incorporation_legal_framework field) with corporate officers and members, recording charter capital, registered office, officers, banking authorization. Cause the seal (physical or as registered through the e-seal sample) to be carved and declare the seal specimen on the National Business Registration Portal within 15 days from ERC issuance, per Article 42 Law on Enterprises. Adopt the Company Charter in its final form with the signature of the legal representative; prepare the Member Registry book and issue capital contribution certificates. Keep the minutes, resolution and registry in Vietnamese in the Company's domicile. Obtain an electronic signature in the name of the Company at a licensed service provider for subsequent tax filing and VAT registration.
required_dossiers: Original or electronic ERC and IRC
Written adoption of the First Members' Resolution signed by all members
Company Charter as registered
Seal specimen (photo or digital scan in .png .jpeg / 4MB) for declaration
Registry of members (Form III-4) and capital contribution certificates
Power of attorney for obtaining the e-signature certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A late seal-specimen declaration triggers an administrative fine of VND 3-5 million; to cure, immediately declare the seal specimen online paying the late-filing fine. If the e-signature provider rejects the applicant, the application may be resubmitted to another licensed CA with strengthened identity documents. Failure to keep the member registry is sanctioned under Decree 50/2016/ND-CP; a supplementary registry can be created with back-dated signatures if signed by all members and notarized.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration, VAT filings, direct investment capital account (DICA) opening, and corporate banking activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Department of Taxation via T-VAN service providers or direct portal; provincial Tax Department (Cục Thuế); State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) accredited commercial banks for DICA opening; the licensed commercial bank acting as account-keeping agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Company's ERC acts as tax registration; within 15 days from the ERC date the Company must obtain an e-signature and complete the initial tax registration on the national tax portal (thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn) using the enterprise code. Pay any adjusted registration fees if tax lines are later added. For VAT and corporate income tax, register the filing obligation and tentative declaration method; if monthly revenues exceed VND 100 billion, monthly VAT; otherwise quarterly. Open the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA - 'Tài khoản vốn đầu tư trực tiếp') at a licensed commercial bank designated in the IRC; the foreign investor shall remit the subscribed charter capital to this account. The ability to use the capital for the fund's operations is unrestricted once the SWIFT receipt is matched to the DICA; all payments to foreign parties related to the branch/fund's operation must go through the DICA under Circular 06/2019/TT-NHNN. Open an operating VND account and a foreign currency account if revenue collection from international digital brands is expected, and obtain a tax identification number (already embedded in the ERC) and register the invoice pattern (if the Company issues e-invoices).
required_dossiers: ERC and IRC
Company Charter
First Members' Resolution and officer authorization
Lease contract and notarized occupancy proof
Investor's passport/corporate documents (CDD)
Beneficial ownership declaration and SOI forms of the bank
E-signature certificate of the Company
Agreement on the opening of DICA and declaration of the purpose: foreign-invested enterprise's capital contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is incomplete, the tax authority sends an electronic request to the taxpayer through the portal; the taxpayer has until the next working day to cure. Late tax registration generates a penalty of VND 5-10 million; if the entity has received revenue without a valid VAT registration, it must pay VAT and late-payment interest of 0.03%/day. If the chosen bank rejects the DICA due to AML/KYC deficiencies, reapply at another licensed listed bank with a more complete SOURCE-OF-FUNDS statement; this does not affect legal incorporation unless capital contribution deadlines (90 days) are missed. Upon expiry of the 90-day contribution window, the company must register the actual contributed capital with the DPI and adjust accordingly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial/physical and occupational clearances for the head office and fund operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Fire Prevention and Fighting Police (Cảnh sát PCCC&CNCH) under the Public Security Department; provincial Department of Construction (Sở Xây dựng) for construction acceptance and structural adequacy; the National/Provincial Environmental Protection Authority (DONRE) only if waste thresholds are exceeded; Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA) for workplace safety registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm that ISIC 6499 office operations do not trigger industrial licensing. Before occupation, the building owner must have completed the fire-safety acceptance inspection under Decree 136/2020/ND-CP (evaluation of the fire-protection systems, extinguishers, emergency exits) and issued the Fire Safety Certificate / Acceptance Decision; the Company as tenant must obtain a copy from the landlord and, where the office is a separate premises (detached floor), submit its own Fire Safety Registration dossier to the local fire police. The Company must ensure the premises comply with structural load and building-use condition requirements of the Construction Law and obtain the landlord's Building Completion Certificate. If the Company has any facility generating hazardous waste >50 kg/month, it must register as a hazardous waste generator and sign a transport/disposal contract with an SBV-approved environmental treatment unit; for pure office operations, no environmental permit is needed. Conduct an occupational risk assessment and workplace safety training under the Law on Occupational Safety and Health; file the workplace safety regime (Bảng kiểm soát an toàn) with DOLISA and the labor usage registration when the first employee is hired. Arrange employee medical checks at licensed health facilities and a fire-fighting self-defense team in accordance with the Fire Law.
required_dossiers: Copy of Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate and fire safety appraisal decision (for the building)
Lease contract and proof of lawful use of the floor/space
Fire Safety Registration dossier (sealed floorplans, fire extinguisher layout, evacuation route)
Construction completion acceptance or structural load statement from building owner
Occupational safety and health registration (for the Company's office) and six-month health check records
List of staff and fire-safety training certificate of the self-defense firefighting team
Waste declaration (if any hazardous waste is generated; otherwise a simple self-assurance with the waste broker invoice)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Fire Safety Police identify deficiencies, they issue a written notice requiring rectification within an aggregate of 30 days; the Company shall appoint a qualified fire-protection consultant to perform the adjustment and re-submit the acceptance dossier. Non-submission subjects the organization to a fine of VND 30-50 million under Government Decree 144/2021/ND-CP; after the fine, the dossier can be completed retroactively. If DOLISA flags lack of workplace-safety training, conduct training immediately and pay administrative penalties of VND 5-10 million; the corrective certificate is then issued without further inspection if no serious accidents occurred.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: None applicable for ISIC 6499 (office-based non-bank financial services); if any ancillary physical premises or data-center-like server rooms are established, the competent industrial control authority is the Department of Industry and Trade (DOIT) only for industrial production or importation of manufacturing equipment, which is not engaged here. The relevant physical regulatory authority is the Provincial Fire Prevention and Fighting Police (PCCC) under the Provincial Public Security and the Provincial Department of Construction for building-use inspection.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial operating license is mandated for a foreign-invested LLC conducting non-dilutive revenue-based financing. The Company instead operates under its ERC/IRC and the legal regime for non-credit financial institutions. It must specifically refrain from 'deposit-taking' and from lending to consumers; the revenue-based agreements must be drafted as commercial purchase-of-future-receivables contracts or B2B financing under the Civil Code, not as bank credit operations. If the Company later decides to offer any consumer lending or crowd-lending activities, it would require a license under the Law on Credit Institutions No. 47/2010/QH13 (as amended) and State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) approval — this is outside the current scope.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MoNRE) for national-level EIA determination; Provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) for environmental registration and waste control.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category IV / No EIA and No Environmental Permit required under the Law on Environmental Protection No. 72/2020/QH13 and Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP. The revenue-based financing fund operates solely in an office environment without production, discharge, or waste generation above permit thresholds; it is not a 'project likely to cause adverse environmental impacts'. If the Company leases space in a grade-A office tower, the building owner's Environmental Permit and wastewater discharge permit suffice for the entire building; the Company only needs to execute a waste contract for office solid waste with a licensed collection operator.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For office use: domestic wastewater must be connected to the municipal sewer system and, if discharged to surface water, must meet QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT (domestic wastewater) or QCVN 40:2011/BTNMT for industrial discharge if co-mingled. No VOCs or fuel-combustion emissions are produced; if a backup diesel generator is installed, the exhaust must comply with QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT and the fuel storage must be within the fire-safety approval. Solid waste: non-hazardous office waste must be declared under the waste-tracking QR code regime of Decree 08/2022; hazardous waste (printers' toners, electronic waste, spent batteries, fluorescent tubes) must be stored with segregated containers and, if accumulating to more than 50 kg/month, the Company must register as a hazardous-waste generator with the DONRE and transfer the waste under a contract with a licensed transporting/treating unit and keep manifest receipts for 5 years.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate (Giấy chứng nhận thẩm duyệt thiết kế PCCC) and Fire Safety Acceptance Decision (Văn bản nghiệm thu PCCC) under Decree 136/2020/ND-CP, covering the building and the Company's leased office area, with an evacuation plan, fire alarm system, portable extinguishers and an assigned self-defense firefighting team; the FPPC must be obtained before bringing the office into use. Structural clearance: obtain a copy of the building's Construction Completion Acceptance (Nghiệm thu hoàn thành công trình) from the landlord to demonstrate that the floor load and use classification are suitable for office/finance operations; any interior partitions, vault installations, or raised floors must be covered by a certified structural calculation if they exceed free-load limits. Occupational safety: register the workplace with the provincial DOLISA under the Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH13; conduct hazard identification and annual safety training; arrange pre-employment and periodic health examinations; provide required personal protective equipment for low-risk office work. Civil defense: if the premises is a multi-storey building, the Company's lease must confirm compliance with 'conditions for use of buildings for office services' (Nghị định 06/2021/NĐ-CP on quality management and maintenance of construction works); if the building is within a security protection area, obtain the Public Security clearance before lease execution.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT / Tổng cục Thuế) under the Ministry of Finance; primary national electronic tax portal at https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn; e-invoice management portal at https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn; business registration integrated with the National Business Registration Portal (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign investor must first obtain an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and an Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) from the provincial Department of Planning and Investment / industrial zone authority. Upon issuance of the ERC, the LLC automatically receives a permanent Vietnamese tax identification number (MST / mã số thuế). The enterprise must then file Form 01-DK-TCT (Tax Registration Declaration) with the local Tax Sub-Department or via the GDT electronic portal within 10 working days of ERC issuance. Supporting documents include the IRC, ERC, notarized legal representative passport, the LLC's charter, and a designated office lease agreement. The MST is used for all CIT, VAT, employer-side PIT withholding, and foreign contractor tax obligations. Where the LLC is established inside an Export Processing Zone (EPE), additional registration at the one-stop customs / zone management authority is required, but the MST process is identical.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. The LLC is a resident corporate taxpayer subject to national Corporate Income Tax (CIT) at the standard 20% rate on its worldwide Vietnamese-source income; offshore passive income (including royalty and financing income sourced from abroad) is generally taxable if it is attributable to a Vietnam-resident entity, subject to treaty relief. There is no pass-through eligibility for LLCs under Vietnamese law. A wholly foreign-invested LLC is not a transparent entity for Vietnamese tax purposes; dividends repatriated to the parent are separately subject to a 0% withholding rate (standard regime) if all Vietnam CIT obligations have been settled. Revenue-based financing income may be characterized for foreign contractor tax purposes only if payments are made by a Vietnamese payer to a non-resident; in the present structure the funded digital brands are overseas, so the LLC is the local holding/financing vehicle and the FCT position is neutralized.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vietnam does not operate a check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch passthrough election. Available statutory choices include: (i) election between the credit-invoice VAT method and the direct method (only for small atypical taxpayers; a foreign-invested LLC is generally mandated to use the credit-invoice method); (ii) election to apply CIT incentive codes (e.g., 10-year preferential 20% for eligible new investment projects, 15% for EPE high-tech undertakings, 4-year CIT exemption and 50% reduction for certain socialized sectors) as filed on the tax declaration; (iii) election to issue e-invoices either via a GDT-coded approval channel or via a registered self-issuance solution subject to API submission; and (iv) for cross-border royalty/financing arrangements, the enterprise may elect to apply a Double Tax Agreement (DTA) limitation on benefits if the ultimate investor is resident in a treaty jurisdiction. No hybrid mismatch election exists, and the LLC cannot elect to be treated as a disregarded branch.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax / thuế giá trị gia tăng); a national, credit-invoice system administered by the GDT; supply of goods and services for business purposes, importation, and high-frequency digital-facing services all fall within the VAT string.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VND 100,000,000 (annual revenue from taxable goods/services, per the Law on Value Added Tax and its implementing Decrees; however, any enterprise with an IRC/ERC must register for VAT immediately regardless of this threshold—the 100 million dong floor in practice applies only to micro-households and small traders, not to a corporate LLC).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory full e-invoicing in XML format since 1 July 2022 under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. Every commercial invoice must be generated in the GDT-defined XML schema with a digital signature and a QR code. Two regimes exist: (i) Invoices with tax-authority codes: the invoice is transmitted to the GDT system in real time via the GDT-approved supplier endpoint; the GDT stamps an encrypted code and returns it to the seller before the original is delivered to the customer (real-time fiscal clearance). (ii) Invoices without pre-issued tax-authority codes: a compliant enterprise self-generates the invoice, and the e-invoice data must be transferred to the GDT portal within 24 hours of issuance (batch API submission). For high-risk taxpayers or for claims of export VAT refunds, the GDT routinely mandates the coded real-time clearance route. E-invoice data exchange is performed via the GDT's API gateway service; approved service providers (such as MISA, Viettel, BKAV) act as intermediaries, and foreign-owned LLCs must integrate their ERP/accounting software to produce GDT-schema XML documents and submit via those AUN-approved channels. Failure to issue compliant e-invoices or to transmit data within the statutory time window results in administrative penalties and an automatic presumption that the output VAT was not declared.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate and the resulting input VAT refund are available for (a) exported goods physically leaving Vietnam (including sales to Export Processing Enterprises, non-tariff zones, or offshore enterprises for processing/or replacement), and (b) services provided and consumed entirely outside Vietnam (offshore consumption test), including international transport services. For the Revenue-Based Financing Fund's core business: revenue-based royalty-fee income derived from overseas digital brands, where the performance of the financing/royalty agreement occurs outside Vietnam and the payment is received in a foreign currency, may qualify for 0% VAT only if there is no Vietnamese nexus in consumption; if the arrangement is properly characterized as a loan/credit extension, the interest component is VAT-exempt rather than zero-rated; if it is a royalty/licensing fee embedded in a financing instrument paid by an overseas entity and with no service physically rendered in Vietnam, the same 0% route may be claimed. Strict documentation of off-shore delivery, direct customer benefit outside Vietnam, and foreign-currency settlement is indispensable; mere invoicing of an offshore entity is insufficient.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic customs clearance; completed status with valid shipment endorsement) for exported goods; for pure offshore services, a statutory declaration of offshore consumption in lieu of customs declaration
E-invoice with a 0% VAT line item, issued in GDT XML format and confirmed on the CQT e-invoice portal

Bill of Lading (or air waybill / CMR) evidencing shipment from Vietnam port to a foreign destination; for services, the contract and digital delivery records (e.g., service reports, IP logs, platform delivery history)
Foreign sales contract concluded with the offshore digital brand, clearly identifying the parties, the revenue-based royalty/financing formula, and the delivery terms

Bank Inward Remittance Certificate or an equivalent extract from the LLC's foreign-currency account at a licensed Vietnamese bank demonstrating receipt of foreign-currency payment from the overseas counterparty
Payment reconciliation statement mapping each invoice to the corresponding inward remittance and supporting underlying debt/financing schedule
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The GDT and General Department of Vietnam Customs operate integrated digital data-matching and risk screening for all export VAT refund claims. Refund applications in which input VAT continuously exceeds output VAT, where the shipment/payment documentary bundle is incomplete, where the foreign-currency remittance is missing, or where the counterparty is a related party in a low-tax jurisdiction are elevated for mandatory desk audit or on-site inspection. Administrative penalties under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP include: a fine of up to 20% of the underdeclared/refunded VAT amount, plus late-payment interest at the GDT's published rate on the whole clawed-back amount, and suspension of the electronic-invoice issuance status of the enterprise. Criminal exposure arises under the Penal Code 2015 (amended 2017), Article 212 (tax evasion): if the refund is obtained by fraudulently fabricated documents or a sham export, imprisonment can reach 12 years where the value exceeds VND 1 billion; aggravating circumstances (cross-border smuggling, money laundering via the financing vehicle) can extend to 20 years. In any clawback, the GDT retroactively reassesses the entire VAT position (up to 10 prior years), disallows the offsetting input credits, imposes a 20% penalty on all differential VAT, and can require the enterprise to post a guarantee before any future refund is accepted. Directors of a foreign-invested LLC with un-repatriated export proceeds additionally face personal civil liability and possible exit controls if the 180-day foreign-currency repatriation covenant (flowing from the State Bank exchange-control regime) is breached.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV, Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam) — the exclusive central bank, foreign exchange regulator, and licensing authority for all credit institutions and payment intermediaries in Viet Nam.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vietnamese Dong (VND) operates under a managed float with daily SBV reference-rate bands. Current-account transactions are broadly convertible in substance: cross-border trade in goods and services, royalty remittances, revenue-share payments, and profit distributions may be executed through licensed banks upon submission of underlying commercial documentation and SBV purpose codes. Capital-account transactions remain restricted: inbound direct investment capital must be routed through a licensed Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) registered with the SBV, with capital contribution completed within 90 days of the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) issuance; offshore borrowing by the enterprise requires prior registration under SBV regulations on foreign borrowings and repayments by enterprises (as amended). Profit remittances to foreign shareholders are treated as current transfers and are permitted after the annual audited financial statements are finalized and tax obligations are settled; the remitting bank verifies the profit-distribution resolution, the audit report, and the tax-payment confirmation. Liquidation proceeds and non-resident capital redemptions require SBV approval or a certificate of completion of tax/liquidation obligations. In practice, banks apply a transaction-by-transaction authenticity-and-legality review under the prevailing SBV foreign-exchange circulars for trade and service transactions, thereby rendering convertibility high for substantiated current transactions but conditional and documentation-intensive for capital-account events.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SBV Circular 02/2021/TT-NHNN (as amended) and Circular 05/2021/TT-NHNN, all export and current-account service receipts—including royalty income and revenue-share payments remitted to the Viet Nam LLC by offshore licensees—must be repatriated into a foreign-currency account held at a licensed credit institution in Viet Nam within 180 days of the contractual payment due date or, if earlier, the date of service performance. The mandatory surrender ratio is 100% of the export/service proceeds: the full amount must be brought onshore and cannot be retained abroad without prior SBV authorization. If the receiving licensed bank has a foreign-currency purchase need, the enterprise must sell to that bank such amount of the repatriated proceeds as the bank requests; if no purchase demand is raised, the proceeds may be retained in the foreign-currency account indefinitely. The enterprise must submit the underlying sale/service contract, invoice, customs or service-completion evidence, and the beneficiary identification when the proceeds are credited.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW-to-MEDIUM for offshore digital EMIs such as Airwallex, Wise, Decta, or Currenxie. Viet Nam does not recognize foreign electronic-money-institution (EMI) passports and does not permit offshore EMIs to hold VND settlement accounts or to function as the primary treasury bank for an FDI enterprise. Their legally permissible role is confined to (i) operating as an auxiliary foreign collection or expense vehicle outside Viet Nam, and (ii) originating SWIFT/SEPA credit transfers into the LLC's onshore licensed-bank account. Onshore payout and NAPAS ACH/Direct Debit access require a Vietnamese licensed payment-service intermediary under Decree 52/2024/ND-CP on non-cash payments; such EMIs cannot provide local clearing directly. The core legal constraint is that all current-account and capital-account transactions of a Viet Nam-domiciled enterprise must be settled through accounts at licensed credit institutions; using an offshore EMI as the final treasury repository creates FX-repatriation risk, documentation gaps, and SBV exposure, and is therefore not a compliant primary clearing rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory: the LLC's legal representative (Chairman, General Director, or an authorized signatory holding a notarized Power of Attorney) must attend a face-to-face KYC/AML interview and biometric verification at a designated branch of the chosen Vietnamese bank. Pure remote account opening is not available to non-resident directors of a Viet Nam-incorporated financial-services company; the eKYC regime is restricted to low-risk individual retail accounts with monthly transaction caps under SBV Circular 09/2023/TT-NHNN and is not extendable to corporate treasury accounts. At the interview the bank will inspect the original or bank-verified copy of the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC), the LLC charter and register of members, the board resolution appointing the legal representative and bank signatories, and the valid passports or Vietnam residence cards of all authorized persons.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity — the offshore fund sits behind multiple intermediate holding layers and trusts/conduits with no readily traceable natural-person beneficial owner.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A complete register of members from the LLC to the ultimate natural-person beneficial owners in line with Decision 933/QD-TTg and Decree 01/2023/ND-CP; certified passport copies of the UBOs; back-to-back corporate authorization resolutions from each holding level; source-of-wealth evidence for committed capital; and audited financial statements of the offshore fund.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Revenue-financing red flags — recurring USD/VND credits described as royalty or revenue-share may be recharacterized by the bank as unlicensed lending or deposit-taking, triggering Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) obligations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written legal opinion confirming that the ISIC 6499 revenue-based financing / royalty financing model is not a licensable lending business in Viet Nam; master financing agreements characterizing payments strictly as royalty/revenue-sharing consideration; invoices and purchase orders matching each inflow; and a compliance memorandum mapping each transaction to the underlying commercial contract.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction indicators — injected capital originates from a jurisdiction with weak AML supervision or from a jurisdiction not on the SBV's bankable FDI list.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified banking references and prior payment history from the originating fund's banks; FATF/CFATF membership status confirmation; audited fund accounts proving the source of funds; and a sanctions-screen clearing report (UN/EU/OFAC/UK) for all parties to the wire.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity sweep — a large one-day inbound capital injection immediately followed by onward offshore disbursements mimics money-laundering layering or an unlicensed payment business.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved treasury sweep policy; the investment pipeline and signed term sheets; a pre-agreed disbursement cadence with scheduled transfer amounts; SWIFT MT103 narratives referencing the LLC's IRC and underlying contract numbers; and proactive narrative letters to the bank's compliance officer before each sweep.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound FDI capital injection: the offshore fund wires USD via SWIFT MT103 with the SBV purpose code for foreign direct investment equity contribution (mapped to 'Góp vốn đầu tư trực tiếp nước ngoài' / FDI equity contribution). The credit must land in the LLC's USD DICA at the licensed Vietnamese bank within the 90-day capital-contribution window from the date of the IRC. The bank verifies (i) the IRC and the registered investment amount, (ii) the LLC's prior DICA registration with the SBV, and (iii) that the incoming amount does not exceed the remaining registered contribution schedule. The LLC then converts the USD to VND through the licensed bank at the interbank rate within the SBV daily trading band; the conversion ticket and DICA credit advice are retained as statutory dockets. Any excess over the registered amount must be returned or reclassified, and any shortfall requires an amended IRC reflecting the revised contribution schedule.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Onshore disbursements to Vietnamese merchants and operating vendors are executed via NAPAS ACH Direct Debit/Credit and domestic interbank transfers from the VND operational account, keyed to the merchant's beneficiary bank code and purpose code for domestic commerce. Cross-border outbound disbursements—including royalty/licensor payments, SaaS and brand-asset fees, offshore merchant advances, and operating expenses—are executed by SWIFT MT103 with the appropriate SBV purpose code (trade-in-services, royalty payment, or financing operating costs) and substantiated by invoice, contract, and delivery evidence. Physical-goods trade settlements use SWIFT MT700 documentary credits, with a confirming bank for offshore beneficiaries; standby letters of credit under MT760 are available for financial undertakings. Every outbound payment passes the bank's FX, AML, and sanctions release control, including a check of the OFAC, UN, EU, UK, and Vietnamese sanctions lists.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore USD/VND deliverable forwards with licensed Vietnamese credit institutions, tenor up to 365 days, contracted under SBV Circular 02/2021/TT-NHNN for hedging the LLC's committed royalty/revenue-share exposure.

Offshore USD/VND non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) with international counterparty banks, used to hedge the economic VND net exposure arising from the revenue-financing book without requiring onshore delivery.

Onshore USD/VND cross-currency swaps and linked single-currency interest-rate swaps transacted with licensed Vietnamese banks for long-dated treasury hedging of capital, funding, and revenue-repatriation mismatches.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Report (Bao cao thuong nien) to the national business registration database
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Business Registration Office, Department of Planning and Investment (DPI), under the Business Registration Management Agency, Ministry of Planning and Investment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end, by 31 March of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs an administrative fine of VND 2,000,000 - 3,000,000 (approx. USD 85 - 128) per Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; failure to report for two consecutive years triggers forced deregistration (administrative strike-off) by the DPI

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department (General Department of Taxation, Ministry of Finance) and local Statistics Office (General Statistics Office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end (by 31 March); audited financial statements must accompany the filing for foreign-invested LLCs subject to compulsory independent audit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines per Decree 41/2018/ND-CP up to VND 10,000,000 (approx. USD 425) for late lodgement and up to VND 15,000,000 (approx. USD 640) for non-submission; persistent non-compliance may result in tax inspection, surcharges, and forced deregistration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department (General Department of Taxation, Ministry of Finance)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end, by 31 March of the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.03% per day on outstanding tax; administrative penalties per Decree 125/2020/ND-CP up to VND 15,000,000 (approx. USD 640) for late or incorrect filing; chronic failure may trigger tax inspection and administrative strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Compulsory independent audit is mandated for all foreign-invested enterprises (including this FDI LLC), public-interest entities, credit institutions, listed companies, and enterprises with state capital; no revenue or asset threshold exemption applies to an FDI LLC engaged in royalty financing
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) pursuant to the Law on Accounting 2015 and Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC; IFRS may be voluntarily adopted by qualifying enterprises, but annual statutory filings remain VAS-based unless the enterprise is an approved IFRS adopter

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam does not impose a separate annual UBO filing; under Decree 01/2021/ND-CP, any member or shareholding transfer in an LLC must be registered with the DPI within 10 days and the internal register of members updated within 7 days of the transfer; under the AML Law 14/2022/QH15, the enterprise must perform periodic customer due diligence refresh on beneficial owners at least annually
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard Vietnamese CIT rate of 20% applies to the royalty-financing fund. No IP Box or financing-specific preferential deduction exists. Tax holidays (4-year exemption and 9-year 50% reduction) and the 10% preferential rate for 15 years are reserved for licensed high-technology zones, large-scale manufacturing, and socialized sectors, which the non-dilutive revenue-based financing model does not ordinarily satisfy. The fund must observe the interest-expense deductibility ceiling: net interest cost exceeding 30% of adjusted EBITDA is non-deductible under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP. Loss carryforward is capped at 5 consecutive years.
